messages:
nora: noticed ~0.8% invoice-preview delta after routing policy change at 11:42. Preview attributes to cheap-route but ledger uses canonical-route. Anyone on routing rollout?
sam: that was me. router started emitting alias as route_resolution_id. meter expects canonical id.
dina: can we emit both route_alias + route_canonical in event payload? meter can prefer canonical when present.
arnav: also sampling parity broke 0%->3% in shim so dashboards missed ramp. I'll sync sampling configs.
ops-bot: deploybot: tentative rollback scheduled by @sam in 15m.
nora: plan: patch shim to emit both ids, backfill affected window, snapshot ledger before backfill, flag reconciled events. I'll coordinate with billing-ops.
sam: will open PR and run a dry-run reconciler first.
